info.title: Spacebar Server
info.description: Spacebar is a Discord.com server implementation and extension, with the goal of complete feature parity with Discord.com, all while adding some additional goodies, security, privacy, and configuration options.

blacklistedUsernames.description: Usernames nobody can register or change to, case-insensitive. `*` matches any run of characters

secret.description: Write only. An empty string keeps the current secret.

instance.description: Base URL of a Cap Standalone server

hide_premium_badge.description: Leave the premium badge off their profile without touching their premium itself

rights.description: Bitfield of instance rights, as a decimal string. Requires OPERATOR to change.

tag.description: The tag shown next to the user's name. BOT tags only render for bot accounts; AI, OFFICIAL and SYSTEM tags render for anyone.

badge_ids.description: Instance badges shown on the user's profile, in display order

account_standing.description:
Overrides the standing shown on the user's account standing page (AccountStandingState: 100 all good, 200 limited,
300 very limited, 400 at risk, 500 suspended); null works it out from their active violations

classification_type.description: ClassificationType, what the user broke (spam, harassment, ...)

description.description: Shown to the user on their account standing page

expires_in_days.description: How long it counts against the user; omit or null for permanent

appeal_status.description: Resolve an appeal: 2 upheld, 3 overturned (stops counting against the user); null clears the appeal

expires_at.description: New expiry as an ISO timestamp

description.description: Tooltip text shown when hovering the badge

icon.description: An existing icon hash (served from /badge-icons/<icon>.png; unknown hashes fall back to discord's CDN)

icon_data.description: A data: URI image to upload as the icon instead

tag.description: The server tag. Unlike the regular guild profile route there's no length or character limit here; null removes it

badge.description: Server tag badge type: one of the client's (0-40) or the instance's own (10000 and up, some staff only)

badge_color_primary.description: Badge colours as #rrggbb; null uses the badge's own colours

component_status.description: Status to set the affected components to while the incident is open

banner_data.description: Wide banner shown at the top of the pack in the shop, as a data: URI image

logo_data.description: Logo shown on the banner, as a data: URI image

banner_data.description: New banner as a data: URI image, or null to remove it

logo_data.description: New logo as a data: URI image, or null to remove it

hidden.description: Take the pack out of the shop; people who already have its items keep them

type.description: 0 avatar decoration, 1 profile effect, 2 nameplate, 3 profile frame

label.description: What it looks like, read out by screen readers

palette.description: Nameplates: the color behind the name

duration.description: Profile effects: how long one play of the animation lasts, in milliseconds

loop.description: Profile effects: play the animation on repeat

overflow_top.description: Profile frames: how far the top layers reach above the profile card, in pixels at 1200px wide

overflow_bottom.description: Profile frames: how far the bottom layers reach below the profile card

art.description:
Art for a store item, each a data: URI to upload or null to remove. Which ones apply depends on the type:
avatar decorations use image; nameplates static (a still image) and motion (a webm/mp4 video or an animated image);
profile effects effect (an animated image drawn over the profile card), thumbnail and reduced (shown instead when
animations are reduced); profile frames front_top, front_bottom, back_top and back_bottom (1312px wide layers)

Art for a store item, each a data: URI to upload or null to remove. Which ones apply depends on the type:
avatar decorations use image; nameplates static (a still image) and motion (a webm/mp4 video or an animated image);
profile effects effect (an animated image drawn over the profile card), thumbnail and reduced (shown instead when
animations are reduced); profile frames front_top, front_bottom, back_top and back_bottom (1312px wide layers)

aliases.description: Other names people search it by

icon_data.description: Square icon as a data: URI image

cover_data.description: Cover art as a data: URI image

icon_data.description: New icon as a data: URI image, or null to remove it

cover_data.description: New cover art as a data: URI image, or null to remove it

avatar.description: New profile picture as a data: URI image, or null for the default one

body.description: Markdown, sent as the message's text

audience.description: everyone: every user on the instance; staff: only people with admin panel access

recipient_ids.description: Required for selected; numeric user IDs, checked for existence before delivery is queued.

delete_message.description: Also delete the reported message. Needs the MANAGE_MESSAGES right.

send_email.description: Also email the link, when the user has an email address and the instance can send email

revoke_sessions.description: Sign the user out of every session

session_ids.description: The sessions to end; omit to end all of them
